scope.immutability: This file permanently declares source-required coverage. Characterization, observations, metrics, floors, and current dispositions live outside this contract and may never remove a requirement.
scope.acceptance_rule: Each requirement must be resolved in characterization/completion evidence as PASS or explicitly approved APPROVED_UNSUPPORTED_GEOMETRY. FAIL or BLOCKED there prevents completion without mutating this declaration.

context_requirements.bucket_rule: No 32K/default ceiling may be advertised; use only the highest new characterization-proven bucket, capped by min(model context ceiling, 32768)
context_requirements.acceptance_condition: Characterization freezes a supported context bucket, then Tier 1 proves exact token counts plus long-, chunked-, and cached-prefill evidence before acceptance expectations are frozen.

cross_cutting_requirements.capability: Full Llama-3.3-70B weights plus paged KV must fit and execute at batch 32 on four P150 dies.
cross_cutting_requirements.acceptance_condition: Immutable qualification evidence demonstrates this capability for every listed geometry without dropping a profile, workload, or row.

cross_cutting_requirements.capability: The same request must produce invariant stop-truncated output under eval-32 prompt-to-slot rotations.
cross_cutting_requirements.acceptance_condition: Immutable qualification evidence demonstrates this capability for every listed geometry without dropping a profile, workload, or row.

cross_cutting_requirements.capability: Demo and serving execution must use the central trace-region resolver with measured P150x4 size and exact trace/program evidence.
cross_cutting_requirements.acceptance_condition: Immutable qualification evidence demonstrates this capability for every listed geometry without dropping a profile, workload, or row.

cross_cutting_requirements.capability: Missing or incomplete profile-matched metrics permit the full model workload to execute and report observational measurements but cannot claim acceptance; every complete independently frozen floor remains enforced and every target miss fails.
cross_cutting_requirements.acceptance_condition: PASS requires fresh measurements meeting every complete independently frozen floor. When a profile-matched floor is absent or incomplete, the node must execute and report TTFT, decode tokens/s/user, aggregate tokens/s, and applicable accuracy or determinism results as observational evidence; it must not claim acceptance or derive a floor from that run.

cross_cutting_requirements.capability: Every demo case passes cold-write and warm-read cache runs; serving rows pin a BH-specific cache policy and reject fallback.
cross_cutting_requirements.acceptance_condition: Immutable qualification evidence demonstrates this capability for every listed geometry without dropping a profile, workload, or row.
